caption:
does one bad night show on your face?

In a trial of 181 adults, half stayed awake all night. The next day, strangers rated photos of their faces and couldn't tell the two groups apart.

A smaller study found something different after two nights of short sleep: 25 people were rated as looking less healthy and less attractive.

So one rough night is unlikely to show. A run of short nights is what your face keeps.

Save this for the night before a big day.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Holding et al., J Sleep Res 2019. doi:10.1111/jsr.12860
Sundelin et al., R Soc Open Sci 2017. doi:10.1098/rsos.160918
